note: Deep-dive #18. IoT Hub F1 is one free hub per subscription (8,000 messages per day): check there is no other free hub. The simulator refuses runs past 80 % of the daily limit. Stream Analytics bills while Running: stop the job right after. Order: iothub (normal run in the background), job, aggregates, alert.
prepare: python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; python -m pytest -q
# owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az extension add -n azure-iot --only-show-errors; az extension add -n stream-analytics --only-show-errors
az iot hub list --query "[?sku.name=='F1'].{n:name,g:resourceGroup}" -o table   # must be empty: one free hub per subscription
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-18 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-18 -n main -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p "operatorObjectId=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)" --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
# manual (portal): job input and both outputs: Test connection must succeed (role assignments can take minutes); note how long it took
python -m iotlab provision --hub $env:MG_HUB18   # connection strings go to devices.local.json (git-ignored), never printed
az stream-analytics job start -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-18 -n $env:MG_JOB18 --output-start-mode JobStartTime
do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; $st = az stream-analytics job show -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-18 -n $env:MG_JOB18 --query jobState -o tsv } until ($st -eq 'Running')

screens.name: alert
prepare: $env:MG_SENT_TODAY18 = Read-Host 'Messages already used today (portal: IoT Hub overview)'
also: Right half of the split (browser, labadmin): storage account > the alerts container: the blob with COLD_ROOM_TOO_WARM lines for coldroom-02 only. Note the real time from the door-open reading (tick 13, about 65 s into the run) to the first alert line (it includes the window and the late-arrival wait) and say it in the narration.

teardown: az stream-analytics job stop -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-18 -n $env:MG_JOB18   # stops billing at once, also if the group delete is delayed
Remove-Item devices.local.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item build -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item Env:MG_HUB18, Env:MG_JOB18, Env:MG_ST18, Env:MG_SENT_TODAY18, Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
